body:
'If you feel like experimenting, take half a tab'
I obtained a gram of salvia 5x, about 20 trips worth. I started out with about a half of a small pinch on top of some weed. A very nice and brightened buzz occured. For a week I smoked a half a pinch to a pinch to check out the effects, I had some of the effects you have read about in other acounts.
This high was in no way scary or uncontrollable, but I started having the effects come on at work by themselves for several hours and go away for awhile then come on when sleeping and wake me up. I got to a point where I was worried I'd done something to my mind, but thankfully this went away after a few days. I think it had built up in my brain and took a while to wear off.
